description: ISM SVD dominant direction analysis on V2 48-sec 32D Takens vectors (121-126 AU)

dominant_svd_mode_per_step.interpretation: Perfectly stable oscillation along fixed direction across 6.4-min window

mean_ism_field_rtn.interpretation: Predominantly tangential, consistent with Burlaga et al. 2019 draped ISM field

svd_vs_mean_relationship: SVD dominant variability direction is roughly perpendicular to mean field -- consistent with Alfvenic fluctuations propagating along draped field
physical_picture: Draped interstellar field, Alfvenically oscillating in the plane perpendicular to its mean, with 1.46 effective dimensions of phase-space variability. The 32D pathion associator detects algebraic order because near-planar phase-locked fluctuations produce strong CD associator cancellations.
